dict.string: Recense adds an event to your calendar only when you press Add to Calendar on a dated line in Draftpad.
Recense opens Matters and Raven only with Face ID.
Recense finds your other paired devices, and the hub on your Mac, over Bluetooth and Wi-Fi, with no internet, to carry files between them and to show what changed on the Mac.
Recense turns what's playing into captions on this device.
